messages:
eva: Heads-up — eval CI failing on quant bring-up for llama-3b q4_k. Smoke suite shows semantic-similarity down 6% vs fp16 baseline. CC @mike @sanjay
ci-bot: [build #5821] eval-smoke: FAILED — see logs https://ci.redwood/dev/5821 :x:
mike: on it. which runner? gpu-accelerated quant branch?
eva: runner=eval-runner-v2, image=quantizer:v3, job=smoke-llama3b-q4k
laura: can you paste failing diff? i saw a similar blip last week but that was tokenization edgecase.
eva: here are samples from failing tests:
```
prompt: "Summarize the policy in one sentence."
fp16: "The policy requires users to agree to data sharing."
q4_k: "The policy asks users to share their data publicly if they consent."
similarity(fp16,q4k)=0.68 -> baseline 0.74
```
sanjay: hmm wording shift, could be quant noise or postprocess detokenization. did batch size change?
mike: runner config unchanged. quantizer change landed in commit a1b2c3d (float->int clamp) yesterday.
eva: tagging the commit: a1b2c3d — maybe clamp with different scale? :thinking:
ci-bot: GitHub action run link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quantizer/actions/591
laura: can someone repro locally with seed and same quant flags? i can try on my dev GPU.
mike: i'll run quick perf + similarity locally, started job on q4 test node.
sanjay: also check the eval harness metric: semantic-similarity uses sentence-bert embeddings + cosine. did evaluator lib bump?
eva: good call — eval-e2e bumped sentence-transformers from 2.2.0->2.3.0 in the same deploy window (commit f9e8d7)
mike: oh nok — two simultaneous changes. we need to know which caused drift.
laura: propose: repeat CI with (A) new quant + old eval-e2e, (B) old quant + new eval-e2e. which is faster to spin?
mike: i can spin both in parallel on two nodes. starting A and B now.
eva: thanks. tagging @oncall-ml in case rollouts need freeze.
oncall-ml: acknowledged. will hold canary if both fail >5% reg.
mike: results: A (new quant + old eval)=drop 5.9%, B (old quant + new eval)=+0.2%
mike: so regressions reproduce only when quantizer is new. leaning quant change as culprit.
sanjay: can we bisect inside commit a1b2c3d? it's a small change, maybe the clamp scale param.
mike: bisect shows delta introduced in patch that changed scale computation from 127->128 in int8 mapping.
eva: that shift could bias decimal rounding across tokens, affecting sentence embedding outputs.
laura: next step: revert scale change in quantizer and run smoke. if revert fixes, we'll roll back commit and cut a patch.
mike: ran revert locally: similarity back to 0.75 (baseline 0.74) on smoke set.
eva: ok: revert PR drafted: #8392. tagging reviewers @sanjay @laura
sanjay: approve for rollback. also add unit test in quantizer for scale edgecases.
laura: i'll add a small eval-harness regression test that checks semantic-similarity within epsilon for the smoke prompts.
eva: should we hold the release? oncall-ml?
oncall-ml: yes — hold canary until revert is in staging and smoke passes. marking release-blocker.
eva: created a follow-up ticket INF-3142 to track: "quantizer scale regression — revert + tests + postmortem"
mike: i'll merge revert + run full eval CI. will ping thread when green.
laura: also note we should add monitoring for embedding distribution shift in dashboard (alerts if mean cosine drops >0.03).
eva: agreed. adding dashboard task to INF-3142.
mike: CI green on revert. smoke pass. will schedule canary rollout for tomorrow 02:00 UTC.
eva: thanks all. closing triage for now. :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: Note: deployment freeze lifted? none — revert merged into staging.
